compiled_state.title: Implement forward_compat_probe step exercising 4 identity-critical Jira operations on throwaway issue
compiled_state.author: Test
compiled_state.description:
## Story DD Coverage
- dd-2: Forward-compat probe exercises label-write, property-write, JQL-search, property-REST-read on throwaway Jira issue

Replace forward_compat_probe stub in plugins/dso/scripts/dso_reconciler/forward_compat_probe.py. Creates throwaway Jira issue via AcliClient in try/finally (finally always deletes throwaway). Exercises 4 sub-operations in order: label_write (add dso-id:<uuid>), property_write (set dso_local_id), jql_search (verify key in results), property_rest_read (verify value equals uuid). Short-circuit on first failure. Record all sub-op results in details['sub_operations']. Cleanup failure goes to details['cleanup'] but does NOT flip ok=True to False.

## TDD Test Spec
Given mocked AcliClient where create_issue returns 'TEST-123' and all four methods succeed; When forward_compat_probe invoked; Then StepResult(ok=True), all four sub-ops in details in order, delete_issue called once. When set_issue_property raises RuntimeError; Then ok=False, message contains 'property_write failed', only label_write and property_write in details (short-circuited), delete_issue STILL called once.

## testing_mode: RED
